lines.t: I've been walking through shadows, celebrating lives
Christmas trees and Easter eggs before my blinded eyes
But he spoke from heaven, said these things I despise
Modern holidays, a man dressed up in disguise
His voice cut through the darkness like a trumpet in the night
Come away from their traditions, come and walk into my life
His days, not mine, pass over the lamb he gave
His days, not mine, remember how he saves
His days reveal his love, the plan throughout the ages
His days, not mine, written on these holy pages
His wrath burns against the lies, his jealousy's a flame
But His mercy flows forever when, when we honor His name
Halloween and Santa Claus, they profane what He holds dear
Abominations in His sight that cost Him many tears
The Sabbath rest and holy feast, supported times divine
Show the depths of Yahushua's love and how His glory shines
He bled upon that tree for us, unconditional and pure
Now He calls us to His holy days, His covenant secure
His day is not mine, Passover the lamb He gave
His day is not mine, remember how He saves
His days reveal His love, the plan throughout the ages
His day is not mine, written on these holy pages
His wrath burns against the lies, His jealousy's aflame
But His mercy flows forever, when we honor His name
I see his pain, I feel his heart breaking in two
When we trade his appointed times for what the world wants us to do
His love is infinite, healing, warm, the meaning of all life
But in his righteousness and wrath he'll cut through sin like a knife
Life understanding comes with knowing who He really is
The fullness of His person, unconditional love, that's His
His days, not mine, pass over the lamb He gave
His days, not mine, remember how He saves
His days reveal His love, the plan throughout the ages
His days, not mine, written on these holy pages
His wrath burns against the lies, his jealousy's a flame
But his mercy flows forever, when we honor his name
Come out from among them, he whispers to my soul
Keep my holy days and watch your spirit become whole
From glory unto glory, by grace upon his grace
Yahushua, Yahuwah
I long to see your face
His days, His days
His love revealed in His days
guitar solo
We'll be right back.
